authorship: Every exported pose is cropped from a generated atlas. Local processing detects gutters, extracts, converts atlas resolution by one fixed ratio where needed, registers feet, pads and assembles. No procedural weapon drawing or pose interpolation. Original generated alpha is retained in source files.
